clue.text: Sea Cat moving principal performer

parts.note: the main is an old poetic word for the open sea

indicators.note: moving suggests the letters of the word cat are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A ship or ferry called the Sea Cat is on the move.
explanation.definitionFit: The headline performer at a show is the main act, the star turn after any support.

clue.text: Brothel-keeper married first man to come along

parts.note: Adam is the first man in the Bible

explanation.surface: A brothel-keeper wed the first man who turned up.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman running a bordello is traditionally called by this title, a crossword-favourite synonym.

clue.text: Admission from muse entertaining us in pub

indicators.note: in places the combined muse-and-us letters inside the word for pub

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so the muse's name takes the word us inside it

parts.note: Clio is the Muse of history

explanation.surface: A poet confesses something after their muse joins them for drinks at the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: Clio is the Muse of history; 'entertaining' and 'in' are two nested containers, the inner one built first.
explanation.definitionFit: Admission in the sense of being let in or added: to be admitted into a group is to be included.

clue.text: Bit of kebab's in this drink

indicators.note: a bit of the phrase means only a stretch of its letters is wanted, running across the words kebab's in this

explanation.surface: Someone finds a piece of kebab floating in their drink.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a strong green aniseed-flavoured spirit, a variant spelling of the liqueur made with wormwood.

clue.text: Sadly he started to drink Directors — and work as thespian

indicators.note: to drink means to take in, so the shuffled letters swallow the directors' word
sadly signals that the letters of he started are knocked out of shape

parts.note: the anagram fodder, taken letter by letter
a company's directors together form its board

explanation.surface: A man regrettably took to the bottle, and the board of directors had to keep working through it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sadly' gives TREADTHES from HE STARTED; 'to drink' takes the directors' word in near the end, before the final S.
explanation.definitionFit: The boards are the stage, so walking them is the idiom for acting professionally.

clue.text: Support band not quite sincere — songs lacking content

indicators.note: not quite means the word for sincere is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: true means sincere, as in a true friend

indicators.note: lacking content means the inside of the word songs is emptied, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: A music critic says a support act lacks sincerity and its songs have no substance.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgical belt worn to hold in a hernia is this kind of supporting band.

clue.text: Hero Weasley occasionally enters in this manner

indicators.note: enters means the chosen letters go inside the word for in this manner

parts.note: thus means in this manner

indicators.note: occasionally means only every other letter of Weasley is used, here the second, fourth and sixth

explanation.surface: Harry Potter's friend Ron Weasley now and then comes in like this, a hero.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian slayer of the Minotaur is a hero of Greek mythology.

clue.text: Make one higher education tenure vacant

parts.note: uni, short for university, is higher education

indicators.note: vacant means the word tenure is emptied of its middle letters, keeping only its ends

explanation.surface: A university must merge its departments as tenured posts stand empty.
explanation.definitionFit: To join things together into a single whole is to combine them into one.

clue.text: Respect changes in royal staff

indicators.note: changes signals the letters of respect are rearranged

explanation.surface: Attitudes towards the servants in a royal household are shifting.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch's ceremonial rod of office is a staff carried as a symbol of sovereignty.

clue.text: Obtaining heart for transplant as well

indicators.note: for transplant means the letters of obtaining heart are moved around into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A patient gets a donor heart ready for a transplant operation.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means additionally, on top of what was already agreed.

clue.text: Game birds

definitions.meaning: a pastime of skimming flat stones so they bounce across water
waterfowl of both sexes, female and male

explanation.definitionFit: The stone-skimming pastime takes its name from the waterfowl, and literally the phrase names female and male birds.

clue.text: Eagle absorbs one knowing the comic

indicators.note: absorbs means the bird's name takes the letter for one inside it

parts.note: an erne is a sea eagle
I is the Roman numeral one
wise means knowing

explanation.surface: An eagle swallows a clever creature, comically.
explanation.walkthrough: He was the straight man of Morecambe and Wise, a much-loved British TV comedy double act.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the name of a famous British comedian, half of a classic double act.

clue.text: Regretted losing old pot in sea

indicators.note: in places old plus pot inside the word for sea

parts.note: Med is short for the Mediterranean Sea
an urn is a pot or vase

explanation.surface: Someone is sorry to have lost an antique pot at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regretted' looks like the whole definition, but 'losing' belongs with it: to grieve a loss.
explanation.definitionFit: To grieve for a lost person or thing is to feel sorrow at its loss.

clue.text: Pig out before charging tax on duck

indicators.note: on in an across clue puts the tax piece after the duck

parts.note: a duck is a score of nought in cricket, so O

indicators.note: charging means loading, so the tax word is filled with the word for before

parts.note: VAT is value added tax
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: A greedy eater stuffs himself before the government slaps a tax on duck.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT, the UK's value added tax, holds ERE to make VEREAT.
explanation.definitionFit: To gorge, consume to excess, is the slang meaning of pigging out.

clue.text: Rubbish initially appearing in Times

indicators.note: in places that first letter between the two letters for times

parts.note: T is the times sign in multiplication; times as a plural gives two of them

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of the word appearing

explanation.surface: Rubbish is first appearing in The Times newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheap tawdry goods or junk are commonly called this, a synonym of trash.

clue.text: Well down field crew takes helmsman's lead

parts.note: a rowing eight is a crew of eight oarsmen

indicators.note: the lead of a word is its first letter, here of helmsman's

explanation.surface: A rowing crew is steered by its cox, who sets the pace.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner finishing in this position is well back in the field of competitors, a cryptic ordinal.

clue.text: Security men only breaking tool

indicators.note: breaking means splitting open, so the men-only word breaks into the tool

parts.note: a hoe is a garden tool
a stag party or night is for men only

explanation.surface: Security guards, all male, are smashing a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A person held as a pledge that terms will be met is security for a deal.

clue.text: See 9
ICBM in a modified personnel carrier

indicators.note: modified means the letters of ICBM in a are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: An intercontinental missile is fitted into an altered military troop carrier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Personnel carrier' sounds military, but it is a taxi that carries people.
explanation.definitionFit: A small pre-booked taxi transports people, so it is humorously a carrier of personnel.

clue.text: Brave to complain about this Roman

indicators.note: about means the complaining word goes round the Latin word

parts.note: to moan is to complain
hic is Latin, the Romans' language, for this

explanation.surface: A brave soldier complains about a certain Roman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brave' is a noun here: a Native American warrior.
explanation.definitionFit: A brave is a Native American warrior, and this people is a famous Native American tribe.

clue.text: Mark in shelter demands rural property

indicators.note: in places the label word inside the shelter word

parts.note: a cote is a shelter for birds or animals, as in dovecote
a tag is a mark or label

explanation.surface: A sign in a bus shelter calls for land in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: A small house in the country is a typical piece of rural property.

clue.text: Eye royal extremity in underwear

indicators.note: in places the extremity word inside the underwear

parts.note: a bra is underwear
an end is an extremity

explanation.surface: A royal's eye is drawn to the edge of some underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: Private Eye, a British satirical magazine, nicknamed Queen Elizabeth II this.
explanation.definitionFit: The satirical magazine's name for the late Queen, so the royal as that magazine calls her.

clue.text: I must leave medicine out — it's usually found here

indicators.note: must leave says the letter I is taken away from the word medicine
out means the remaining letters are put out of order

parts.note: the letter I as written

explanation.surface: A patient insists they must stop taking medicine since it's always around.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove one I from MEDICINE and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A disease or species native to a particular region and regularly present there is described this way.

clue.text: Skinned boar stuffed with five eggs

indicators.note: stuffed with means the skinned boar letters take the numeral inside
skinned means the outer letters of boar are stripped off, like skin

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: A skinned wild pig is stuffed with five eggs for a feast.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin plural for egg cells, used in biology for female reproductive cells.

clue.text: Meal served up?

parts.note: an early evening meal with a cooked dish, jokingly taken as one served at elevation

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the pun: 'up' suggests lofty, the first word of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The cooked late-afternoon meal of northern Britain, here read as a repast served at altitude.

clue.text: American in GTO shows appreciation

indicators.note: in places the American abbreviation inside the letters GTO

explanation.surface: An American driving a Pontiac GTO sports car shows how much he likes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearty enjoyment or relish is a show of appreciation, as in eating with zest.

clue.text: Communist forces bloody Yankee to carry weapon

indicators.note: to carry here puts the phonetic letter alongside the weapon, carrying it

parts.note: red means bloody, the colour of blood
an arm is a weapon
Y is Yankee in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Soviet troops order a bloodied American to bear arms.
explanation.definitionFit: The Soviet Union's army was named for the colour of communism, so communist forces.

clue.text: Unknown graduate has 19 in for tea

indicators.note: has signals holding something, with the following in
in says the royal letters go inside the unknown and graduate letters

parts.note: Y is an algebraic unknown
a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
the answer at 19 is Private Eye's name for the Queen, and the Queen is ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: An anonymous graduate has the Queen round for tea.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer at 19 stands for the Queen, giving ER. This drink is the South American herbal tea, also called maté.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the South American herbal infusion maté, a kind of tea.

clue.text: Prophetess caught when god takes beach

indicators.note: takes means the god word comes after the beach word, taking it on

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
as means when, as in as I left
sand stands for beach
Ra is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: Someone is caught out just as a god seizes the seashore.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trojan princess cursed to utter true prophecies no one would believe, so a prophetess.

clue.text: Former kamikaze dropping content inside wreck

indicators.note: inside places those end letters within the wrecking word

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or wreck

indicators.note: dropping content means the word kamikaze loses all its inner letters, keeping just its ends

explanation.surface: A one-time suicide pilot ditched his payload into the wreckage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Former' looks like 'previous', but means one who forms or creates.
explanation.definitionFit: One who forms or shapes something is a creator, a cryptic reading of the word former.

clue.text: One wearing black, reflecting, whose grief was legendary

indicators.note: wearing means the numeral has the reversed black word around it like clothing
reflecting means the word for black is read backwards, as in a mirror

parts.note: ebon is a poetic word for black
I is one, in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone in black mourning clothes thinks of a figure famous for grief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' plays double duty, also opening the definition: one whose grief was legendary.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this queen wept endlessly for her slain children and was turned to stone.

clue.text: Ionic, as deciphered, reveals the capital

indicators.note: deciphered means the letters of ionic, as are decoded into another arrangement

explanation.surface: An inscription in Ionic Greek, once decoded, reveals the name of a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' tempts towards architecture after 'Ionic', but it is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: The divided city that is seat of government of Cyprus is that nation's capital.
